content: I’m working with the Brasca–Clemente SDG development, which currently uses a custom choice-reduced Lean/Batteries/mathlib stack around Lean 4.30. Has anyone tried porting that setup to a current stable Lean release? In particular, I’m curious whether there is an actively maintained “choice-free” or “less-choice” Lean/mathlib branch, and which core changes are still necessary today.

@Snir Broshi Yes, I have seen that. It hasn't moved for a while. In fact, I am already using their code under 4.30 to formalize a theory of microsquares ala Kock–Lavendhomme. It might be quicker to fork and implement the changes myself.

Done. The Brasca–Clemente SDG code is ported to 4.33.0. If anyone has use for it, the general public is invited to look at, use, fork, copy, steal, or otherwise fold, bend, spindle, or mutilate it.

I didn't notice this thread yesterday, thanks for the interest in our work! I plan to update everything next week or so, I will have a look at what you have done.
@Riccardo Brasca Excellent, I am delighted. I look forward to any insights.
